_about: Night market switches and cosmetic routines (docs/maps/night_market.md). The four layout decisions Ross has not answered yet are built as their recommended option A; each is one line here so flipping it is a data edit (and, where the line says so, a re-run of a generator). Nothing here is code. Others read it: Audio Designer (market_tone, hush), Gameplay Programmers (town life, VS-43), the junkyard and arena generators (one_way_after_loader, colossus_in_phase_1).

market_tone.decision: A whisper market (Quiet Hours curfew is real, the market murmurs; goes loud when Kasp falls, flag market_loud). B loud and cheerful.
market_tone.affects: audio, patrol hush, ambient bark volume; no geometry

repair_shop.decision: A the repair shop is the old dock-office room (market_repair, off the Wharf), Otis moves to the Forge, hatch from the hideout. B a tenth tiny room beside the hideout door and Otis stays in his office.
repair_shop.affects: rooms and placements (B would add a room to make_market_rooms.py and rooms.json)

one_way_after_loader.decision: A one way from the loader onward (junkyard map). B she can climb out and walk back to town.

colossus_in_phase_1.decision: A the dormant colossus is visible from the first frame of the arena. B hidden behind a hangar door until phase 2.

flags.job_main_taken: main job taken; Courier Pass given; opens Gate 4's barrier
flags.patrol_hush: set for 15 s while the Signals patrol is within 8 m of an NPC
flags.market_loud: set after the boss; the market goes from whisper to loud

patrol._about: Cosmetic Signals patrol in Tarp Square: two wolves walk this loop on the hour at 1.2 m/s. Scenery, not enemies (no combat in town). Waypoints are [x, z] in room metres. Until the town-life work (VS-43) they stand at their idle spots (mk_sq_wolf_a / mk_sq_wolf_b). NPCs within hush_radius_m drop to a whisper and the stall music ducks for hush_s seconds (flag patrol_hush). They never block a door.

pending.junk_j1: the junkyard's first room (docs/maps/junkyard.md); Gate 4's barrier door leads to it with spawn from_market
